title: Single cell analysis of iPSC-derived midbrain organoids
author: Maria Jose Perez J.

steps.title: Initialize Environment and Load Data
steps.instruction: Install and load required R libraries and import 10x Genomics h5 files for six samples (GC1, MUT1, GC2, MUT2, GC3, MUT3) into Seurat objects.

substeps.instruction: Load libraries: Seurat, patchwork, ggplot2, cowplot, magrittr, and tidyverse.

Read h5 files: 1GC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, 1MUT_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, 2GC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, 2MUT_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, 3GC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, and 3MUT_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5.
Create Seurat objects for each sample.
Merge all six objects into a single object named MUT.combined using the Reduce function.

steps.title: Filter Cells and Genes
steps.instruction: Perform quality control filtering on the combined Seurat object based on gene counts and mitochondrial ratios.

substeps.instruction: Calculate log10GenesPerUMI for each cell.
Filter cells based on: nFeature_RNA >= 250, log10GenesPerUMI > 0.80, and mitoRatio < 0.20 (implied by the logic provided).
Filter genes to keep only those expressed in more than 10 cells.
Create a new filtered Seurat object (filtered_seurat) and save as 'seurat_filtered.RData'.

steps.title: Cell Cycle Scoring and Initial PCA
steps.instruction: Normalize data and assign cell cycle phases to the filtered object.

substeps.instruction: Normalize data using NormalizeData.
Load 'cycle.rda' and perform CellCycleScoring using g2m_genes and s_genes.
Identify 2000 most variable features using the 'vst' method.
Scale data and run PCA.
Visualize PCA colored by cell cycle phase.

steps.title: Sample-Specific Normalization and SCTransform
steps.instruction: Split the object by sample identity to perform individual normalization and SCTransform regression.

substeps.instruction: Split filtered_seurat by 'orig.ident'.
For each sample: perform NormalizeData, CellCycleScoring, and SCTransform, regressing out 'mitoRatio', 'S.Score', and 'G2M.Score'.

steps.title: Data Integration
steps.instruction: Integrate the SCT-normalized samples to remove batch effects.

substeps.instruction: Select 3000 integration features using SelectIntegrationFeatures.
Prepare the SCT list object using PrepSCTIntegration.
Find integration anchors using FindIntegrationAnchors (normalization.method = 'SCT').
Integrate data using IntegrateData and save the result as 'integrated_seurat.rds'.

steps.title: Clustering and Visualization
steps.instruction: Run the standard Seurat workflow for dimensionality reduction and cluster identification.

substeps.instruction: Set DefaultAssay to 'integrated'.
Run PCA and UMAP (dims 1:40).
Determine optimal dimensions using ElbowPlot (ndims = 40).
Find neighbors (dims 1:40) and find clusters with a resolution of 0.6.
Assign cluster identities and scale all genes for visualization.
Generate UMAP plots grouped by clusters and split by 'orig.ident'.

steps.title: Marker Identification and Analysis
steps.instruction: Identify conserved markers across samples and visualize specific gene expression.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the number of cells per cluster per sample and save to 'n_cells.csv'.
Identify conserved markers by calculating the average log2FC across all 6 samples (GC1-3, MUT1-3).
Extract the top 100 genes by average fold change per cluster and save to 'Clusters_top100.csv'.
Visualize target genes (e.g., SOX2, DCX, TH, NEUROD4) using FeaturePlot, VlnPlot, and DotPlot.

steps.title: Sub-clustering and Differential Expression
steps.instruction: Perform targeted analysis on specific cell subsets (e.g., Neurons) and export differential expression genes.

substeps.instruction: Subset the data for specific populations (e.g., Neurons_subset).
Repeat the conserved marker analysis for the subset and save to 'Clusters_top100_Neuronsubset.csv'.
Perform differential expression analysis for specific clusters (e.g., Radial Glia, C11Neuron, Cluster 20) and export results to CSV files.
